text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD: Latency SLO breach detected on /v1/stream (p99 > 2.5s). Region: eu-west-1. Streaming stall indicator trending up. AlertID=alert-2026-03-14-11.

hana: ack @incident-bot 1 Im on call, paging infra and runtime.

ravi: I see p95/p99 spike across multiple model routes. p95 from 320ms -> 1.0s, p99 from 900ms -> 3.6s. Streaming stalls jumped to ~5%.

clara: checking host telemetry: host-gpu-07 has sustained high blkio wait and repeated cgroup blkio "weight limit reached" entries. dmesg has a couple of nv driver timeouts.

infra-bot: trace sampler: high tail latencies correlate with long serial KV writes to model-state-store (s3-proxy) from several long-lived streaming sessions.

ravi: digging into runtime logs 1 heavy small-write pattern from tenant=stark-industries, session_count=6, token_rate=20k/min per session. Worker pods: gen-122, gen-124.

hana: immediate mitigations: 1) apply soft token cap to tenant stark-industries (0.6) 2) evict sessions on host-gpu-07 gracefully 3) cordon host-gpu-07 4) restart gen-122. Ops, please execute.

ops-bot: runbook invoked: noisy-neighbor-isolate (initiated by hana).

ops-bot: tenant throttle applied: tenant=stark-industries token_rate_limit=0.6 (soft). Active session drain in progress (grace window 25s).

ops-bot: cordon host host-gpu-07: SUCCESS. No new pods will be scheduled.

ops-bot: restart pod gen-122: executing restart -> SUCCESS. Driver reset completed, nv errors cleared on restart diagnostics.

clara: after throttle+restart (T+7m) metrics: p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 1.4s, streaming stall -> 1.8%. Improvement but still above baseline.

ravi: kernel excerpt from host-gpu-07:
```
[ 98765.123456] blkio: weight limit reached for cgroup /gpupool/tenant-stark
[ 98765.123789] cgroup: cpuacct cgroup created
[ 98766.000001] NVRM: GPU lockup - schedule timeout
```
Also seeing many 4KB synchronous writes from runtime to /var/run/model-kv (s3 proxy adapter).

hana: support, notify customers and post status banner. Mention affected tenants: stark-industries, greenmarket, quickcart.

support: posting banner and opening priority DMs to affected accounts. No data loss reported at this stage.

clara: root-cause hypothesis: noisy tenant (stark-industries) producing many concurrent streaming sessions that generated high small-block IO to model KV backend; blkio shares on shared GPU host hit limits, causing kernel-level waits and NV driver stalls which amplified tail latency and streaming stalls. cgroups amplified the effect.

ravi: short-term followups: enable per-tenant IO shaping, default soft token caps on streaming, add an alert for streaming-stall-rate > 1%, add blkio "weight limit" watch event sourcetype to alerting rules.

hana: ops tasks created: TASK-1301 (per-tenant IO limiter), TASK-1302 (streaming-stall alert), TASK-1303 (dedicated warm pool for high-throughput streamers).

ops-bot: TASKs created. TASK-1301, TASK-1302, TASK-1303.

clara: suggestion: add a runtime metric for per-worker nv driver reset counters and expose blkio throttle events per host in the console for quicker triage next time.

ravi: plan for RCA: 24h to draft, include kernel logs, blkio event timeline, tenant traffic profile, and mitigation runbook updates. I'll own the RCA with eng-runtime and infra input.

hana: severity: Sev2 (SLO breach impacting multiple customers). Customer impact: elevated latency and streaming stalls for three customers; stark-industries primary contributor.

support: marking related tickets and flagging affected customers for follow-up and credits as appropriate.

clara: continuing to monitor for 60 minutes. Will verify no residual heavy sessions on host-gpu-07 and confirm throttling effect in logs.

hana: handing monitoring to ravi for the next 2 hours. I'll be reachable for escalation. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring.

ravi: preliminary root cause = noisy neighbor (stark-industries) causing multi-tenant IO contention; cgroup/blkio limits triggered kernel blocking which increased tail latency and streaming stalls. Action items recorded in TASK-1301..1303.

support: post-mitigation update sent.

hana: final: collating artifacts into incident ticket. RCA draft due in 24h. Closing on-call handoff.

ops-bot: Incident ticket updated: status=monitoring, owner=ravi, rca_due=24h.

ravi: thanks all. I'll drop the RCA link here when ready. :spiral_notepad:
